sources.title: Sourav Chatterjee, Stats 310A (Math 230A) Lecture Notes
sources.locator: PDF pp. 105–108 / printed pp. 101–104: §8.5.3 Polish-space Slutsky, §8.8 Cramér–Wold, and §8.9.1 multivariate IID CLT with its projection proof.

contents.name: IID influence limit from a supplied vector expansion
contents.reason: Used as an independent full-text treatment of the CLT and Slutsky route. The authored items prove their wrappers locally and cite the actual published CLT, Slutsky, and Cramér–Wold suppliers.

contents.name: Fixed finite-dimensional projection and multivariate CLT route
contents.reason: The notes supply the Cramér–Wold and iid vector-CLT ingredients; the independent-group characteristic-function combination is proved locally.

sources.title: Rick Durrett, Probability: Theory and Examples, 5th ed.
sources.locator: §3.10, Theorems 3.10.5–3.10.7, PDF pp. 204–209 / printed pp. 196–201: weak convergence, characteristic-function convergence, Cramér–Wold, and the multivariate IID CLT proof.

contents.name: Multivariate iid CLT supplier for the terminal influence theorem
contents.reason: Independent book treatment of the finite-dimensional IID CLT. Its theorem is used only as a source cross-check; the group-combination argument is supplied locally.

contents.name: Cramér–Wold and multivariate iid group limits
contents.reason: The book proves the iid vector-CLT and Cramér–Wold ingredients. The non-identically distributed finite-group combination remains a complete local proof.

sources.title: Peter Bartlett, Theoretical Statistics, Stat 210B Lecture 16
sources.locator: Complete 13-page lecture; PDF pp. 9–12 give the multivariate delta-method statement and proof, with the final CMT/Slutsky step.

contents.name: IID estimator expansion with a vector Slutsky step
contents.reason: Supports the finite-dimensional Slutsky use. The exact vector supplier is quoted and proved in the current library; no estimator expansion is imported from these notes.

contents.name: Deterministic group scaling and a vanishing expansion remainder
contents.reason: Supports the continuous transformation and Slutsky steps after the local independent-group sum proof; no group influence expansion is imported.
